_comment: The repos you actually have installed, keyed by GitHub full_name. Copy this to starred_installed.json and edit. Each entry is ONE of: a version_cmd Wren runs to read the version; a plugin key naming a Claude Code plugin ('<plugin>@<marketplace>', read from ~/.claude/plugins/installed_plugins.json, no command run); or a static version you maintain by hand, which goes stale silently — use it only when neither of the others fits. Only repos listed here get an 'Installed' column on /starred. Delete the _comment key. A command not on the launchd PATH (see the plist) can be an absolute path.
